title: Best of Hong Kong and Bali Holiday
alt: Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong skyline at dusk
transport: Private transfers, city tours and guided day tours

stops.name: Hong Kong
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Tsim Sha Tsui East hotel, walking distance from the harbour

activities.name: Hong Kong sightseeing tour
activities.description: Victoria Peak by tram, Aberdeen harbour and its sampans, Repulse Bay and the jewellery workshops, with a guide for the day.

activities.name: Ocean Park Hong Kong
activities.description: A full day ticket for the marine park on the south side, with the cable car over the headland, the aquarium and the pandas.

program.name: Hong Kong
program.description: Three nights in Kowloon with a city day by peak tram and sampan, and a full day at Ocean Park on the south side of the island.

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Kintamani
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Small villa property on the quiet edge of Ubud

activities.name: Kintamani with the jungle swing
activities.description: Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani, the crater lake view, Tegenungan waterfall, the Tegalalang terraces and the jungle swing.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Two nights inland after the city, with a coffee plantation road up to the Kintamani crater and the rice terraces at Tegalalang.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Tanah Lot and Nusa Penida
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Large pool hotel ten minutes from Kuta beach

activities.name: Monkey forest with Tanah Lot sunset
activities.description: Taman Ayun, the Alas Kedaton monkey forest and the lake temple at Beratan, finishing with sunset at the sea temple of Tanah Lot.

activities.name: Nusa Penida west coast by speedboat
activities.description: Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Bay and Bubu beach, the island's four best known stops.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Two nights on the coast to finish, with a temple day that ends at Tanah Lot and a full island day on Nusa Penida.

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Hong Kong for three nights is exactly right. Long enough for the peak and Ocean Park, short enough to still want Bali.
expert.tip: Take an Octopus card on arrival in Hong Kong, it works on the tram, the metro and the Star Ferry. Fly to Bali in the morning so you still have a rice field evening in Ubud.

summary: Eight days across two very different places: three nights in Kowloon for Victoria Peak, Aberdeen harbour and Ocean Park, then five in Bali for Kintamani, the jungle swing, sunset at Tanah Lot and a day on Nusa Penida.
included: Included: 7 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; Hong Kong sightseeing tour; Ocean Park day ticket; Kintamani and jungle swing tour; monkey forest with Tanah Lot sunset; Nusa Penida west coast tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Hong Kong to Denpasar flight, which we can add; visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
